novel_features.name: Free-slot finder
novel_features.description: Find open time blocks of a given length across several calendars in one query.

novel_features.name: Cross-calendar conflict detection
novel_features.description: List events that overlap across two or more calendars in a time window.

novel_features.name: What-changed-since
novel_features.description: Show events created, updated, or cancelled since a date, by update timestamp (updatedMin), deletions included.

novel_features.name: Meeting-load analytics
novel_features.description: Count meetings and summed booked hours per day, week, or calendar over a window.

novel_features.name: ACL audit across calendars
novel_features.description: Flatten every calendar's sharing rules into one who-has-what-access table.

novel_features.name: Conflict-guarded create
novel_features.description: Create an event but abort (or warn) with a typed exit code if it overlaps an existing event.

novel_features.name: Attendee/RSVP rollup
novel_features.description: Summarize accepted/declined/tentative counts per event across a window.
